bullets.title: Meet the 19-Year-Old From Kazakhstan Who Remixed ‘Roses’ Into a Hit (NYT)
bullets.note: ](https://archive.is/vsr2J)**.** Sometimes it seems impossible to beat the odds. And sometimes the ruts seem too deeply dug. But when you come across someone like Imanbek Zeikenov, you gain a little hop in your step and a little optimism in your spirit. From the NYT: “Imanbek Zeikenov \[[@realimanbek](https://twitter.com/realimanbek)\] is 19 years old and lives with his parents in the small village of Aksu in Kazakhstan. He studied railway engineering at school, and until last December, held a day job at his local train station. But everything changed in the summer of 2019, when he discovered a song called ‘Roses’ by the Guyanese-American rapper and singer [Saint Jhn](https://www.instagram.com/saintjhn/?hl=en).”

bullets.section: What I’m listening to (related to the above) —
bullets.title: Roses (Imanbek Remix)
bullets.note: ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2zToEPpFEN8) by [SAINt JHN](https://www.instagram.com/saintjhn/?hl=en) ([YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2zToEPpFEN8), [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/24Yi9hE78yPEbZ4kxyoXAI), [Apple Music](https://music.apple.com/ca/album/1482621265?i=1482621326&uo=4&app=music&at=1010lNLq&lId=21476802&cId=ID&sr=1&src=Linkfire&itscg=30440&itsct=catchall_p1&ct=LFV_7de2daee6702ee8144fa3a2e87e716ec&ls=1)). Some fun facts: The song has seen [more than NINE BILLION plays](https://tokboard.com/songs/6738439639826287365) on TikTok, became [a wild hit on Snapchat](https://www.rollingstone.com/pro/news/snapchat-filter-propelled-song-up-charts-saint-jhn-990492/), and it [reached No. 1 on the United Kingdom’s Official Singles Chart](https://www.officialcharts.com/chart-news/saint-jhn-holds-on-to-number-1-for-a-second-week-with-roses__29225/). _Rolling Stone_ [crowned it](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/song-of-summer-roses-1055159/) as the song of the summer, and it has [scored a Grammy nomination](https://www.grammy.com/grammys/news/2021-grammys-complete-nominees-list). Not bad for an accidental collaboration between SAINt JHN and a 19-year-old who used to work in a local train station, eh?

bullets.title: Guardians of the Amazon
bullets.note: “As the Amazon rainforest faces a crucial tipping point amidst the increase of illegal logging activities, [Dan Harris](https://tim.blog/2020/11/19/dan-harris/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf) \[[@danbharris](https://twitter.com/danbharris?lang=en)\] and his team embed with the Guardians, a small indigenous group taking up arms to hunt down illegal loggers and fight for their land.” For a taste of the action, [see the trailer here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JPu2kK4zBVs). This is a topic I care a lot about. For another way to help preserve the ecosystems of the Amazon, which includes both the lungs of the planet and indigenous communities, take a look at the [Amazon Conservation Team](https://www.amazonteam.org/). For my interview with the co-founder, [Mark Plotkin](https://tim.blog/2020/09/30/mark-plotkin/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf), ethnobotanist and protégé of the legendary [Richard Schultes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richard_Evans_Schultes), [please click here](https://tim.blog/2020/09/30/mark-plotkin/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf).
